lineage: ABCD (2019) -> LockBit 2.0 (2021) -> LockBit 3.0/Black (2022) -> LockBit 4.0 (2025) -> LockBit 5.0 (Sep 2025); disrupted by Operation Cronos Feb 2024 but relaunched
summary: Most prolific RaaS of 2022-2023; affiliates buy access or exploit edge devices (Citrix Bleed, PaperCut, ScreenConnect), then use RMM tools, AdFind/network scanners, Mimikatz and PsExec/GPO for domain-wide deployment. Data is stolen with the bespoke StealBit tool or rclone/MEGA before encryption. LockBit 5.0 (Sep 2025) ships Windows, Linux and VMware ESXi lockers with stronger anti-analysis.
uniqueTraits: Group Policy abuse to push the encryptor and disable Defender domain-wide

chain.procedure: Affiliates exploit internet-facing appliances and apps: Citrix Bleed CVE-2023-4966 (session hijack on NetScaler), PaperCut CVE-2023-27350, Fortra GoAnywhere CVE-2023-0669, Apache Log4j, F5 BIG-IP CVE-2021-22986, ConnectWise ScreenConnect CVE-2024-1709.
chain.noAtomicReason: Local catalogue has no T1190 exploit atomic (and plans never add exploit code); validate with perimeter/WAF/appliance log detections instead.
